title: Legal Operations Analyst
description:
Legal Operations Analyst
Location: Miramar, FL | Remote (Must reside in or around Miami/Fort Lauderdale area)

Company Overview:
ARC Group is partnering with a Fortune 500 hospitality company to recruit a Legal Operations Analyst for their Miramar, FL office. This role is initially a contract position, with the potential to extend or convert to a permanent opportunity. The position is primarily remote, with occasional on-site engagement at the office.

Role Overview:
We are seeking a detail-oriented Legal Operations Analyst to support the legal team in managing law firm invoicing and vendor operations. This role is critical in ensuring accurate and timely processing of invoices while maintaining vendor compliance.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Manage the full lifecycle of law firm invoicing, ensuring accuracy and compliance.

  • Set up and onboard legal vendors efficiently.

  • Conduct first-line review of legal invoices for accuracy, compliance, and policy adherence.

  • Collaborate with internal legal and finance teams on invoice and vendor management.

  • Maintain records, reporting, and documentation related to legal spend.

Experience & Education:

  • Experience: Minimum of 2 years in legal operations, law firm billing, or related financial/administrative roles.

  • Education: High school diploma required; bachelor’s degree preferred.

Required Skills & Qualifications:

Soft Skills:

  • Highly detail-oriented with excellent organizational skills.

  • Strong communication and collaboration abilities.

  • Ability to work independently and manage multiple priorities.

  • Professional and discreet in handling sensitive legal information.

Technical Skills:

  • Experience with legal billing platforms (CounselLink preferred).

  • Familiarity with eBilling systems and invoice workflows.

  • Proficiency in Excel and document management tools.

  • Understanding of legal operations or law firm billing practices.

Work Environment:

  • Fast-paced legal department with a high volume of invoices.

  • Collaboration with external law firms and internal stakeholders.

  • Primarily remote, with occasional onsite requirements at the Miramar office.

  • Candidates must live in or around the Miami/Fort Lauderdale area.

title: Tax Intake Specialist
description:
Tax Intake Specialist
Jacksonville, FL 32256 | On-Site
🕒 Full-Time | Monday–Friday, 9:00 AM–6:00 PM (One evening until 8:00 PM/week)

ARC Group is currently recruiting a Tax Intake Specialist to join our client's growing Tax Resolution Team in Jacksonville, FL. This is an exciting opportunity to support individuals and businesses seeking relief from complex tax issues while helping the internal team move cases forward efficiently.
As the first point of contact for prospective clients, the Tax Intake Specialist plays a key role in building trust, gathering information, and qualifying leads for the Tax Advocacy team. If you're personable, organized, and thrive in a fast-paced environment, we want to hear from you.
Key Responsibilities:
  • Professionally respond to inbound phone inquiries, providing a positive first impression
  • Assess caller intent and determine qualification as a prospective client
  • Manage and follow up on leads generated via web submissions and after-hours inquiries
  • Work from call queues to meet or exceed daily and weekly performance goals
  • Prioritize outreach efforts based on the company's lead engagement strategy
  • Conduct concise, scripted interviews to evaluate client eligibility and needs
  • Maintain control of the conversation while building rapport and trust
  • Seamlessly transition qualified leads to the Tax Advocacy team for further engagement
  • Redirect non-qualifying inquiries to appropriate internal contacts
  • Accurately document conversations and update client records in the CRM system
  • Perform additional administrative or client service duties as assigned by management
Requirements:
  • Minimum 1 year of experience in a business office, call center, or client-facing role
  • High school diploma or equivalent required
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills
  • Strong attention to detail and note-taking abilities
  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced, quota-driven environment

Would you like to know more about this role? For immediate consideration, please send your resume directly to D.A. Longhi by emailing him directly at dlonghi@arcgonline.com or calling him at 904-289-8828. You can also apply online and view all our open positions at www.arcgonline.com.

title: Environmental Professional  | Des Moines, IA
description:
Environmental Professional
On-Site | Des Moines, IA

Overview
ARC Group is seeking an Environmental Professional to support our client's environmental compliance and remediation initiatives in Des Moines, IA. This position plays a key role in ensuring compliance with federal, state, and local environmental regulations, including RCRA, NPDES, and SPCC.

The ideal candidate will have extensive experience managing environmental programs, leading audits, mentoring staff, and engaging with regulatory agencies and contractors to drive environmental excellence.

Key Responsibilities

  • Mentor and guide junior environmental staff on compliance systems, procedures, and best practices.

  • Develop and implement tools, templates, and processes to enhance environmental data collection, reporting accuracy, and compliance performance.

  • Conduct and manage field inspections for operating facilities and construction projects.

  • Lead continuous improvement of compliance programs based on audit results and regulatory updates.

  • Represent the company in regulatory and industry association committees addressing emerging environmental issues.

  • Identify and resolve compliance applicability issues through risk-based analysis and cross-functional collaboration.

  • Manage all environmental programs for assigned assets and projects, ensuring full regulatory compliance.

  • Oversee the permitting process for all environmental media (air, water, waste) from application through approval.

  • Evaluate and manage contractor and consultant performance to ensure quality and cost-effectiveness.

  • Coordinate and lead agency inspections, representing the company in compliance and enforcement discussions.

  • Collect and review environmental samples (air, water, waste) to ensure accuracy and regulatory alignment.

  • Participate in spill drills, tabletop exercises, and provide 24/7 on-call emergency response support, including reporting incidents to regulatory agencies.

Education & Experience

  • Bachelor's degree in Environmental Science, Natural Science, Engineering, or related field preferred.

  • 6+ years of experience in environmental compliance, permitting, or remediation.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

  • Strong understanding of federal and state environmental regulations, including RCRA, NPDES, and SPCC.

  • Proven ability to prepare and manage permit applications, reports, and regulatory correspondence.

  • Excellent analytical, technical writing, and documentation skills with strong attention to detail.

  • Ability to interpret and apply environmental regulations, technical manuals, and company policies.

  • Skilled in data analysis, compliance tracking, and risk assessment.

  • Strong communication and presentation skills; ability to train and influence others.

  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office and environmental compliance software.

  • Ability to operate relevant monitoring and field equipment.

Why Join
This is an opportunity to play a key role in advancing environmental compliance and sustainability initiatives for a respected organization while working on complex and high-impact projects.

Compensation & Benefits
Our client offers a highly competitive total rewards package, including:

  • Variable compensation: Annual performance-based bonus opportunity.

  • Retirement benefits: Up to 14% company contributions to 401(k), which includes 6% quarterly profit sharing.

  • Equity opportunity: Employee stock purchase program with company discount.

  • Paid time off: Minimum of 3 weeks PTO, plus sick time and floating holidays.

  • Comprehensive coverage: Health, dental, and vision insurance plans, along with additional employee wellness benefits.

title: Mortgage Loan Officer | Plano, TX
description:
Mortgage Loan Officer
Plano, TX
 

ARC Group is seeking motivated Loan Officers to join our Fortune 500 client’s team in Plano, TX. This role involves providing exceptional customer service and expert mortgage guidance in a fast-paced call center environment. You will assist new and existing clients in exploring mortgage options for purchasing a home, refinancing, or obtaining a home equity line of credit.

Position Overview

The Loan Officer is responsible for answering inbound calls and initiating outbound outreach to help clients identify the most suitable financing solutions. This includes analyzing financial goals, recommending loan products, completing mortgage applications, collecting documentation, and keeping clients informed throughout the lending process.

This position is subject to SAFE Act registration requirements. All employees engaged in residential mortgage origination must register with the federal registry system and maintain good standing. Failure to meet SAFE Act requirements may result in disciplinary action, up to and including termination.

Key Responsibilities

  • Deliver exceptional client care by actively listening and understanding client needs.

  • Handle inbound and outbound calls to provide guidance on mortgage products, refinancing, and home equity solutions.

  • Analyze financial and credit data to recommend appropriate lending options.

  • Submit mortgage applications and assist clients in gathering required documentation.

  • Maintain ongoing communication with clients, referral partners, and internal teams via phone, email, and messaging systems.

  • Follow defined lending processes, policies, and risk management guidelines.

  • Identify opportunities to recommend additional banking products or services through partner referrals.

Required Qualifications

  • 1+ year of sales and mortgage experience with a strong focus on relationship-building and client service.

  • Proven ability to assess client needs, recommend financial solutions, and promote alternative products.

  • Strong communication skills (verbal, written, and non-verbal) with a professional, confident presence over the phone.

  • Ability to manage multiple tasks and thrive in a high-volume environment.

  • Comfortable working weekends and/or extended hours as needed.

  • Technical aptitude to learn and navigate multiple platform systems.

  • Demonstrated ability to balance sales performance, operational risk, and client relationship care.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Contact center experience.

  • Knowledge of mortgage loan products (Conventional, Jumbo, Government).

  • Familiarity with FHA/HUD guidelines, underwriting, processing, and closing procedures.

  • Ability to analyze complex financial data and provide alternative financing solutions.

  • Strong consultative skills with the ability to ask key questions and uncover opportunities.

Core Competencies

Attention to Detail | Client Solutions Advisory | Customer Focus | Critical Thinking | Pipeline & Loan Management | Collaboration | Problem Solving | Referral Identification & Management | Credit Documentation

Education & Schedule

  • Education: High School Diploma or GED required.

  • Work Schedule: Monday–Friday, 10:00 AM – 7:00 PM (Central) with rotating Saturdays, 8:00 AM – 3:30 PM.

  • Training Schedule: Monday–Friday, 8:00 AM – 5:00 PM (Central) for approximately 8 weeks (subject to change).

title: Litigation Attorney - Plainville, MA
description:
LITIGATION ATTORNEY – PLAINVILLE, MA
ARC Group has an immediate opportunity for a Litigation Attorney with strong experience in the residential foreclosure process! This position is located in Plainville, MA. This is a fantastic opportunity to join a well-respected organization offering tremendous career growth potential.
 
At ARC Group, we are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace where everyone feels valued and respected. We believe that diverse perspectives lead to better innovation and problem-solving. As an organization, we embrace diversity in all its forms and encourage individuals from underrepresented groups to apply.
 
Candidates must currently have PERMANENT US work authorization.  Sorry, but we are not considering any candidates from outside companies for this position (no C2C, 3rd party / brokering).


We are seeking an experienced Litigation Attorney licensed in Massachusetts with a strong background in the residential foreclosure process. The ideal candidate will have hands-on experience handling foreclosure-related litigation, from reviewing case files and titles to representing clients in court. This role offers the opportunity to join a dynamic legal team focused on delivering efficient, compliant, and client-focused representation in the creditors’ rights and foreclosure space.

Essential Functions:
  • Possess strong knowledge of residential foreclosure process and general real estate law, including litigation, title curative / title claims, and post-judgment litigation (with preference given to candidates with experience handling FDCPA, RESPA, and TILA claims, as well as creditor rights generally).
  • Review and analyze pre- and post-judgment title issues to ensure marketable title to our clients or identify potential title issues and assess resolution options.
  • Conduct legal research.
  • Draft substantive pleadings, motions, legal opinions, and memoranda.
  • Appear at court hearings, mediations, depositions, and other required appearances on behalf of clients.
  • Analyze cases, propound focused discovery, and assist clients with responses to discovery requests, including identifying responsive documents and reviewing documents for potential issues.
  • Communicate effectively, written and verbally, with clients on issues that may affect foreclosure, provide legal advice on proposed strategies, and assess the range of outcomes based upon the legal and business considerations that apply.
  • Develop and implement focused litigation plans to further the efficient and ethical resolution of litigated matters.
  • Maintain case management status report and meet regularly with paralegals on assigned matters.
  • Manage a large volume of workload effectively and efficiently.
  • Meet minimum monthly billable hour requirements.
  • Regularly review and approve pre-bills for time input by attorneys or paralegals on assigned files.
Requirements:
  • J.D. from an accredited law school.
  • Massachusetts Bar, member in good standing; admission in the Rhode Island and New Hampshire Bars preferred.
  • At least 3-5 year of practice – civil litigation/trial experience, with preference given to candidates that possess experience in the area of residential or commercial real estate, foreclosure, FDCPA, RESPA, and TILA claims, as well as creditor rights generally.
  • Computer savvy and experience with the Microsoft Suite of programs, case management software; strong court room appearance; civil jury or non-jury trial experience; keen attention to detail; organized; ability to multi-task; possess strong work ethic and willingness to be part of a team.
Required Skills
  • Strong knowledge of residential foreclosure process and general real estate law
  • Litigation experience, including title curative/title claims and post-judgment litigation
  • Ability to review and analyze pre- and post-judgment title issues
  • Proficiency in drafting substantive pleadings, motions, and memoranda
  • Excellent communication and courtroom appearance skills
Preferred or Nice-to-have Skills
  • Experience handling FDCPA, RESPA, and TILA claims
  • Creditor rights experience
  • Admission in the Rhode Island and New Hampshire Bars
  • Commercial real estate experience
  • Years of Experience: At least 3-5 years of civil litigation/trial experience, with a preference for experience in residential or commercial real estate, foreclosure, and creditor rights.
     
ARC Group is a Forbes-ranked a top 20 recruiting and executive search firm working with clients nationwide to recruit the highest quality technical resources. We have achieved this by understanding both our candidate's and client's needs and goals and serving both with integrity and a shared desire to succeed.

At ARC Group, we are committed to providing equal employment opportunities and fostering an inclusive work environment. We encourage applications from all qualified individuals regardless of race, ethnicity, religion, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, disability, or any other protected status. If you require accommodations during the recruitment process, please let us know.
 
Position is offered with no fee to candidate.
